---
type: memory
title: "FOIL steps for (x + 3)(x + 5)"
---

For $(x + 3)(x + 5)$, match each **FOIL step** to the **product** it gives.

| Step | Product |
|:-----|:--------|
| First | $x \cdot x = x^2$ |
| Outer | $x \cdot 5 = 5x$ |
| Inner | $3 \cdot x = 3x$ |
| Last | $3 \cdot 5 = 15$ |

## Hint
**F**irst: the first term in each bracket. **L**ast: the last term in each bracket.

## Hint
**O**uter: the two terms on the far ends, $(\underline{x} + 3)(x + \underline{5})$. **I**nner: the two in the middle, $(x + \underline{3})(\underline{x} + 5)$.

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % area model: each FOIL product is one box of the rectangle
  \draw[seg] (0,0) rectangle (4,3.2);
  \draw[seg] (2.4,0) -- (2.4,3.2);
  \draw[seg] (0,1.2) -- (4,1.2);
  \node[above] at (1.2,3.2) {$x$};
  \node[above] at (3.2,3.2) {$+5$};
  \node[left] at (0,2.2) {$x$};
  \node[left] at (0,0.6) {$+3$};
  \node at (1.2,2.2) {$x^2$};
  \node at (3.2,2.2) {$5x$};
  \node at (1.2,0.6) {$3x$};
  \node at (3.2,0.6) {$15$};
  \node at (2,-0.6) {$x^2 + 5x + 3x + 15$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

## Solution
Add the four products and combine the like terms in the middle:
$$
\begin{aligned}
    (x + 3)(x + 5) &= x^2 + 5x + 3x + 15 \\
                   &= x^2 + 8x + 15
\end{aligned}
$$
